title: Exercise Training Stimulates the Release of Glutathione Peroxidase 1 ( GPX1 )‐Enriched Extracellular Vesicles That Promote Angiogenesis
comparison_or_design: Exercise-associated EVs (ExerVs) versus sedentary EVs (SedVs), retaining the actual donor-to-plasma-to-EV material chain where supported.
time_scope: Collection immediately after the final bout of the 4-week endurance-training protocol.
excluded: EV injections, HUVEC assays, immobilization/recovery and GPX1 liposome experiments
Cryo-EM/NTA and other independent characterization assays
population_or_material: Selected mouse plasma-derived EV preparations Donor identity is biological-source context; totals do not establish individual chains.
requested_items: Exercise versus sedentary regimen, training duration and plasma collection relative to final bout
